question: Who was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maria Corina Machado**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Maria Corina Machado** is a prominent **Venezuelan** politician and the founder of the liberal political party **Vente Venezuela**. She has been a leading figure in the movement for **democracy** and **human rights** in **South America**.
 
• She was awarded the **Nobel Peace Prize** in **2025** (as per the provided data) for her unwavering commitment to **peaceful transition** and her leadership during the **2024 presidential elections** in **Venezuela**.
 
• Despite being **disqualified** from holding public office by the **National Electoral Council** of the **Maduro regime**, she successfully mobilized millions of citizens to participate in **democratic processes** and **civic resistance**.
